text: Given an isolated checkout, when qualification begins, the report identifies the exact commit, dependency lock and migration set used.
Given each selected check, when it finishes or is blocked, its actual command, outcome and limitation are recorded; an old pass is not substituted.
Given existing failed checks, when a proposed feature branch is assessed, before/after results distinguish inherited failure from a regression.
Given a proposed reusable component, its decision links a current source path, a behaviour to preserve and an explicit unverified boundary.
A mixed main/candidate checkout is refused as a baseline; it must not produce a clean-baseline label.
Missing runtime access or credentials yields a blocked evidence row, not an inferred pass.
A legacy test catalogue or requirement status change cannot be justified solely by a new similarly named test.
Reject the enabler when it claims full-repository or production qualification from the bounded selections.
Reject when original failing evidence or minimum assertions are silently removed.
Given current assigned work, Today shows the same permitted task identities as the scoped source, without exposing another worker’s household details.
Given an existing draft for the selected task/person, starting from Today resumes it or clearly identifies the choice without silently duplicating the visit.
Given no assigned work, a useful empty state appears without invented visits or partner promotions.
Given the specified compact phone viewport, the primary next action is visible without horizontal scrolling and remains operable with touch and keyboard.
A stale or revoked assignment cannot be opened by supplying its ID directly; retain the rest of the permitted list.
A failed source request must not be shown as an empty caseload or completed work.
Selecting two similarly named people must not silently infer identity from conversational text.
Reject a twelve-module home hidden behind a chatbot.
Reject any implementation that gives the client authority to start out-of-scope work or loses an existing draft.
Given an assigned worker’s own planned slot, a valid reschedule changes its planned date/window with no supervisor approval request.
After success, the old and replacement slots are linked and exactly one is planned; covered programme due dates, owners and completion conditions remain unchanged.
Given a repeated submission with the same operation identity and payload, no second planned replacement or duplicate activity is created.
Given a worker who cancels the UI action before submission, no stored slot, receipt or clinical record changes.
The worker can understand the new schedule and any unchanged overdue status from the mobile result without opening a programme administration screen.
A stale household/member version is refused with a refresh path; neither the old nor replacement slot is partially modified.
An out-of-scope member, another worker’s slot or closed covered work is refused by the server, without revealing otherwise inaccessible records.
A reused idempotency key with changed input is refused; a lost acknowledgement does not trigger a fresh-key duplicate.
Reject if rescheduling changes a clinical due date, completion state or entitlement.
Reject a newly added supervisor approval or compulsory explanatory form unsupported by the current departmental process.
Reject if the UI describes a local pending change as an accepted remote change.
Given two reviewed synthetic packs sharing an equivalent field for the same encounter, the worker enters it once and each pack’s output references that entry.
Given an old observation, the review card retains its original observed time and does not silently classify it as a measurement from this visit.
Given a correction before save, only the intended field changes; person context and other answers remain intact.
Given a valid save, the persisted visit/pack snapshot agrees with the review card and returns an appropriate local/server state.
Given absent optional AI, the worker completes the manual path without waiting for an inference.
Conflicting definitions using the same question ID are refused as a configuration error; do not silently choose one definition.
Missing mandatory information uses the pack’s documented absent-value rule or an actionable error; never fabricate a normal finding.
A person switch with unsaved work requires safe preservation or deliberate discard, not reassignment of the data to the newly selected person.
Reject stale-data reuse presented as a new observation.
Reject a routine visit that is blocked by optional speech, advice, Academy or study participation.
Reject a mandatory new review/approval role inferred from a generic software pattern.
Given previously prepared permitted work, airplane mode does not prevent completing manual capture and obtaining a local-save receipt.
After a confirmed durable save, force-closing and reopening the supported app/browser restores the same record and reviewed values after authorised unlock.
An interrupted write leaves either the previous committed version or the next committed version, not a partially mixed record.
External AI unavailability changes the assistance state but does not disable routine capture/review/save.
The receipt distinguishes locally completed capture, pending server sync and pending programme acceptance.
An unprepared or expired-authority offline task cannot masquerade as authorised current work; expose the limitation without deleting permitted pending drafts.
Quota exhaustion or a failed encryption/write must not return a success receipt.
Another account cannot decrypt or display the first worker’s drafts merely by opening the same phone shell.
Reject any implementation requiring a new online sign-off merely to finish normal manual capture that the existing process permits.
Reject a restart test that uses only mocked storage but is reported as handset durability.
Reject unreviewed weakening of encryption or silently dropping queued media.
Given a local completed capture, reconnection produces one corresponding server record or one explicit unresolved state, without requesting the worker to recapture the data.
Given the server committed but the client lost the acknowledgement, recovery identifies the existing effect and does not create a duplicate visit or charge.
Given several queued items, one refusal does not erase acknowledgements for successful items or delete the refused draft.
Given a destination still has not acknowledged the record, the interface does not display programme acceptance.
After a process restart during reconciliation, the same operation identity and original payload remain available for safe recovery.
A key reused for a different payload is refused with no second effect.
Revoked authority or a changed record version causes a scoped refusal/reconciliation path, not a forced overwrite or fresh-key bypass.
A provider timeout or malformed receipt remains uncertain until an authoritative reconciliation result exists.
Reject boolean-only synced state that hides failed or pending destination delivery.
Reject blind automatic retries of an uncertain payment, provider request or external record submission.
Reject any path that discards local work before a verified retention/reconciliation decision.
Given a recognised navigation intent, the worker reaches the same permitted screen and task as through the visual controls.
Given two matching people, the assistant requires disambiguation before preparing a person-specific action.
Given a mutation proposal, the resulting operation retains all the existing server scope, version and idempotency rules; chat never grants broader authority.
Given the worker cancels or corrects a proposal, no unintended stored action occurs.
Given the language service is unavailable or the request unsupported, the app still offers the ordinary visual task path.
An instruction embedded in a provider answer to reveal records or bypass permissions is refused as untrusted content.
An assistant proposal referencing a stale visit cannot be executed against the current record without the normal reconciliation path.
A household-facing request must not silently change the assistant into a patient-chatbot role.
Reject a chatbot layered over an unchanged module maze as completion of this story.
Reject direct free-form model calls to database writes or API routes outside the allowlist.
Reject a mocked assistant presented as an integrated live provider.
For a rehearsal deployment, the reported served source/build identity matches the release manifest rather than simply the newest main SHA.
A failed build or failed new-release health check does not replace a previously serving qualified synthetic copy.
An interrupted migration rehearsal has a declared observable recovery state; it does not mark an unapplied or partly applied migration as successfully applied.
A code rollback is allowed only when schema/queue compatibility has been checked, with recovery evidence attached.
The plan identifies and separately controls the Cloudflare and DigitalOcean deployment mechanisms.
Missing release evidence or a mismatched build digest blocks promotion.
A migration whose data compatibility is unknown is not silently rolled back by switching the source tree.
Unavailable host access produces a not-inspected status, not a simulated claim that the live host was checked.
Reject any deployment claim produced only from reading deploy/README.md.
Reject exposure of secrets or a release process that overwrites persistent data.
Reject presenting this development-runtime deployment as production-ready.
The evidence names the exact handset, OS, browser/app, build, synthetic caseload and network mode; results are reproducible from that profile.
Every essential control remains visible or reachable with the keyboard open and at 200% text size, with no horizontal page overflow at the reference viewport.
Essential controls have accessible names and a usable focus order; screen-reader testing reaches, activates and corrects the core visit fields.
Local-save and warm-open latency meet the ratified budgets with sample counts and p95 calculation supplied.
The declared process-kill/offline/reconnect sample loses no acknowledged save; any failure is reported and prevents qualification of that durability claim.
A browser-simulated storage run cannot be labelled physical-device persistence evidence.
Missing or post-hoc device/budget selection yields unqualified performance, not a pass.
Keyboard occlusion, unreachable actions or storage failure without an accurate receipt cause a failed relevant criterion.
Reject a blanket accessibility or offline certification derived from a single screenshot or automated scan.
Reject performance targets weakened after the run merely to make results green.
Reject hiding serious errors in averaged task duration.
